summary.name: Dream by WOMBO
summary.one_liner: Dream by WOMBO is an AI tool that generates images and cinematic videos from text prompts, using 100+ curated visual styles.
use_cases: Generating stylized images in a chosen art style
Making short cinematic AI videos from prompts
Exploring visual styles for creative projects
Producing illustrations like anime, cartoon or engraving looks
summary.what_it_does: The page presents Dream as a text-to-image and text-to-video generator: users type a prompt and pick a style to create artwork. It advertises over 100 curated styles, with examples including Cinematic, Anime, Baroque, Cartoon, Mechanical, Minimalism, The Cut, Whimsical and Crochet. Output options shown include 1080p resolution and a 4:3 aspect ratio. The page also lists a "Now in motion" feature, indicating video generation alongside still images.
notable: 100+ curated art styles selectable per prompt
Output options including 1080p and 4:3 aspect ratio
caveats: Pricing and plan limits are not stated on the page
Listing describes it as an app, but the page text only shows web-based creation
